notes-doc-page.aDesignNoteFromTheRepo: A design note from the repo — why, not how.

page.aFileLandsUnderThatStorage: a file lands under that storage/ prefix — an upload, an API write, another flow's output
page.aHowToLoadedOnlyWhen: a how-to, loaded only when its description applies; `when: '<'tag'>'` limits it to runs tagged that way
page.aMessageReachesTheFlowS: a message reaches the flow's inbox URL from Resend, Postmark, Mailgun, SendGrid or an email worker — from, subject and text become the task
page.aNameInToolsThatIs: A name in tools: that is not a built-in resolves against the {@workspace.one}’s tools/ first, then the account Library — one copy of a shared tool, every {@workspace.one}’s agents can ask for it. Secrets are substituted server-side; the model never sees the values.
page.aPersonPressesRunTheCli: a person presses Run, the CLI invokes it, or the API is called
page.aPostHitsTheFlowS: a POST hits the flow's hook URL; add signature: github | stripe | slack | hmac and signing_secret: $'{'NAME'}' to have the sender's HMAC checked
page.aStepWithAskOrA: A step with ask: (or a 2! marker) parks the run until a person answers. Parking is durable — the run survives restarts and waits days if it has to — and the platform tells you three ways: the amber banner across every dashboard page, the run’s row on the Runs page, and an email if the {@workspace.one}’s notify: includes awaiting-approval.
page.aWholeFlowAsOneStep: a whole flow as one step
page.anotherFlowFinishes: another flow of this {@workspace.one} finishes (completed by default, or failed / any) — its conclusion becomes the task
page.answerSoonRatherThanPerfectlyA: Answer soon rather than perfectly: a parked run is money already spent on the steps before the gate, holding for one decision. If the answer needs work first, reject with a note — the run history keeps the question and your reason.
page.bringYourOwnModelKeyA: Bring your own model key. A provider: block in AGENTS.md (the whole {@workspace.one}) or in one agent names the endpoint and the secret: provider: '{' name: groq, token: $'{'GROQ_API_KEY'}' '}'. Anthropic-shaped providers — Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Kimi, z.ai, Qwen, Vercel’s gateway, your own LiteLLM — are spoken to directly. OpenAI, Gemini, xAI, Groq, Mistral, Together, Hugging Face and Cloudflare speak Chat Completions, and format: openai reaches them through the runtime’s own translator inside the run sandbox. auth: x-api-key for the few that want the key in that header. foldrun probe '<'model'>' proves a key holds a tool loop before a run depends on it.
page.curatedContextAPersonGaveThe: curated context a person gave the agents — OKF bundles with a `type:` field
page.eachStepReceivesThePreviousGroup: Each step receives the previous group’s results automatically. Big artifacts ride storage/. A step can run another flow with [[flow:name]].
page.emailOrWebhookUrlForRun: email (or webhook URL) for run events; `events: [failed, completed, awaiting-approval]` narrows it
page.everythingOnThisPageIsPlain: Everything on this page is plain markdown in your {@workspace.one} — editable here in the dashboard, or in any editor, and every change is an ordinary git diff.
page.fanOutOneInstancePerCsv: fan out one instance per CSV row, each carrying the header
page.fanOutOneInstancePerElement: fan out — one instance per element of the previous step's output: json array
page.fanOutOneInstancePerLine: fan out — one instance per line of the previous result
page.foldersAreAgentsAFlowIs: Folders are agents, a flow is a numbered list of links, and every capability is a file the agent names in its frontmatter. This page is the whole grammar.
page.holdBeforeThisStepRunsS: hold before this step runs (s/m/h/d, max 30d) — the run parks in the queue, not in a process
page.holdUntilSomethingPostsTheRun: hold until something POSTs the run's event URL (printed in the step's trace) — the body reaches the step; a person can still release it here
page.howManyCallsTheStepMay: how many calls the step may make, per tool or in all — over the agent's limits:, key by key
page.howManyModelTurnsTheStep: how many model turns the step may take before it is stopped
page.httpToolsDeclareAUrlAnd: http tools declare a URL and headers (with $'{'SECRET'}' placeholders); mcp tools point at an MCP server. Scripts run inside the run’s sandbox with FOLDRUN_RUN_ID, FOLDRUN_AGENT and FOLDRUN_DATE in their environment for stamping provenance.
page.oneIsoInstantPassesFiresOnce: one ISO instant passes — fires once, never again
page.oneSyntaxEverywhereAndAutocompletesIt: — one syntax, everywhere, and [[ autocompletes it. Wherever prose reaches a model, a link becomes that thing’s path: a knowledge or memory document ([[sources-of-conveyancers]]), a stored file ([[storage/leads.csv]]), or a folder when you need to say where without naming a file ([[storage/]], [[state/]]). Names match on filename or the doc’s title:/name:, blind to hyphens, underscores and case; anything unmatched passes through untouched, so a typo never breaks a run.
page.openTheRunAndTheWaiting: Open the run and the waiting step shows the question, an answer box, and two buttons. The box is not decoration: whatever you type reaches the step as its instruction, so the gate is a conversation, not a switch.
page.optionalItsFailureDoesNotFail: optional: its failure does not fail the flow
page.overrideForThisStepNearestWins: override for this step — nearest wins: step, flow, agent
page.parksLikeAnApprovalButCarries: parks like an approval, but carries a question — the typed answer reaches the step's prompt
page.repeatMax5UntilThePhrase: repeat (max 5) until the phrase appears in the result
page.routeModelCalls: route this {@workspace.one}'s model calls through your own gateway or key
page.routeToExactlyOneStepOf: route to exactly one step of a group
page.runOnlyIfALineOf: run only if a line of the previous group's result begins with READY
page.runOnlyIfThatCsvHas: run only if that CSV has a data row — for the steps after a fan-out
page.secondsOr45m2hBeforeThe: seconds (or 45m, 2h) before the step is stopped
page.shellCheckThatMustPassOr: shell check that must pass or the step fails — the step's final turn is in the file $FOLDRUN_REPLY_FILE — or contains: / not-contains: / matches: / file: / judge:, the eval vocabulary
page.spendCapInUsdPerMonth: spend cap in USD per month — or `50/day`, `50/week`; unset is no limit. At the cap, new runs are refused until the window turns (running ones finish)
page.step2RepeatANumberTo: step 2 — repeat a number to run steps in parallel
page.stepOptionsIndentedLinesUnderThe: Step options — indented lines under the step
page.stopsAndWaitsForHumanApproval: stops and waits for human approval before running
page.theConventionThatKeepsLinksHonest: The convention that keeps links honest: link what you read, spell out what you write. A link points at something that exists — an input. An output (write the result to workspace/storage/x.csv) doesn’t exist yet, so it stays a literal path.
page.theCronMatchesTimezoneSaysWhere: the cron matches — timezone: says where
page.theFormatModelsTwoKnobsAnd: The format models two knobs and no more: model: and effort:. Everything else a provider accepts goes in params: on the provider block, merged into the request verbatim — temperature, seed, response_format, a gateway’s own routing. A null value removes a field instead of setting it, which is how you stop sending temperature to an endpoint that rejects it. It applies to a format: openai provider; an Anthropic-shaped one is spoken to directly, so set its knobs at the provider.
page.theLongestOneModelReplyMay: the longest one model reply may be for this step, in tokens
page.theOneExceptionIsTheShape: The one exception is the shape of a step line: its first link is the agent the step runs, not a path to read. Every other link on that same line resolves normally — 1. [[extractor]] — read [[sources]] and write storage/x.csv runs the extractor and hands it the real path to the sources document.
page.thePageAtTheUrlChanges: the page at the URL changes, polled every 15m by default — the new content becomes the task
page.theReplyEndsWithOneJson: the reply ends with one JSON value; the next step gets it as data, and a shell verify: reads it on stdin
page.theSameBracketWorksInFrontmatter: The same bracket works in frontmatter, under one rule: if it names a file, you can link it. tools:, skills:, agents:, a step’s delegate: and a flow’s after: all take - [[site_repo]] or a bare site_repo and read them as the same name; secrets, model and size are values, never linked. The brackets say one extra thing: “this is my file” — so in tools: a bare search is the platform group and [[search]] is your tools/search.md. Use the block form when linking; YAML reads [[x]] as a nested list, which works but makes an inline mix hard to read.
page.theSameFormatWrittenByAgents: the same format, written by agents as they learn
page.theStepDoesNotRunThe: the step does not run; the run ends without doing the gated thing
page.theStepProceedsAsItsPrompt: the step proceeds as its prompt already says
page.theStepReadsYourTextAnd: the step reads your text and follows it — “publish, but change the title to X” steers without rejecting a whole run
page.thisStepS: this step's agent picks which of THESE agents run next, one instruction each — the choice set is yours, the picks are the model's
page.toolsIsTheOneListIt: tools: is the one list. It accepts everything — built-in groups, SDK names, and your own tools — with built-ins winning a name clash, so a Claude Code agent drops in unchanged. Name a tool of yours after a built-in and the run says it was shadowed — write [[name]] to mean yours. The older use: key is no longer read: an agent that still has one gets an error quoting the tools: line to write, and node scripts/migrate-use-to-tools.mjs . rewrites every agent in a folder.
page.twoGroupsAreThePlatformS: Two groups are the platform’s own: tools: [search] gives search_files(query), ranked full-text search over the agent’s knowledge, memory, state and storage at every scope (lexical, on the box — nothing leaves it), and tools: [history] gives recall_runs() and read_run(id), the {@workspace.one}’s last thirty finished runs and what they concluded, so a scheduled flow continues where yesterday’s left off instead of redoing it. tools: [peers] gives peers_list() and peers_message(to, text): the other steps running beside it in its parallel group, and a message to one of them, which reaches that agent after its next tool call — a step asks a colleague for what it has instead of guessing or failing.
page.whatTheApprovalBoxShowsFor: what the approval box shows for a gated step — paths under storage/, globs allowed, resolved when the run parks
page.whenARunWaitsForYou: When a run waits for you
page.whenCaseAndUntilReadMarkers: when:, case: and until: read markers, not meaning: a line of the previous result that begins with the word (for until:, a line that is the word). No model decides them. Write the verdict as a headline and they agree with what the agent meant.
page.whenThisStepFailsThatAgent: when this step fails, that agent takes it over — its success continues the flow with its result
page.whereAccumulatedDataLivesFollowsThe: Where accumulated data lives follows the same discipline: a value regenerated each run (a cache, a fetched list) is a run artifact — storage/. A value accumulated across runs (a ledger of dead ends, filed briefs) is {@workspace.one} memory — state/ — because it must travel when the {@workspace.one} does.
page.whyTheFormatIsShapedThis: Why the format is shaped this way, and where it deliberately stops. The rest of this page is what the grammar is; these are the decisions behind it.
page.withEachHowManyInstancesRun: with each: — how many instances run at once (default: all)
page.withOutputJsonAJsonSchema: with output: json — a JSON Schema the reply must satisfy, or the step fails
